name: The Good News According to Luke

verses.text: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.
The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”
He told them this parable:

“\+w Which \+w of \+w you \+w men \+w if \+w you \+w had \+w one \+w hundred \+w sheep \+w and lost \+w one \+w of \+w them wouldn’\+w t \+w leave \+w the \+w ninety-nine \+w in \+w the \+w wilderness \+w and \+w go \+w after \+w the \+w one \+w that \+w was lost, \+w until \+w he \+w found \+w it *
\+w When \+w he \+w has \+w found \+w it \+w he carries \+w it \+w on \+w his \+w shoulders \+w rejoicing *

\+w When \+w he \+w comes \+w home \+w he \+w calls \+w together \+w his \+w friends \+w and \+w his \+w neighbors \+w saying \+w to \+w them ‘\+w Rejoice \+w with \+w me \+w for \+w I \+w have \+w found \+w my \+w sheep \+w which \+w was lost!’ *

\+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w that \+w even \+w so \+w there \+w will \+w be \+w more \+w joy \+w in \+w heaven \+w over \+w one sinner \+w who \+w repents \+w than \+w over \+w ninety-nine \+w righteous \+w people \+w who \+w need \+w no \+w repentance *

“\+w Or \+w what \+w woman \+w if \+w she \+w had \+w ten drachma* \+w coins \+w if \+w she lost \+w one drachma \+w coin wouldn’\+w t \+w light \+w a \+w lamp \+w sweep \+w the \+w house \+w and \+w seek \+w diligently \+w until \+w she \+w found \+w it *

\+w When \+w she \+w has \+w found \+w it \+w she \+w calls \+w together \+w her \+w friends \+w and \+w neighbors \+w saying ‘\+w Rejoice \+w with \+w me \+w for \+w I \+w have \+w found \+w the drachma \+w which \+w I \+w had lost!’ *
\+w Even \+w so \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w there \+w is \+w joy \+w in \+w the \+w presence \+w of \+w the angels \+w of \+w God \+w over \+w one sinner repenting.”*
He said, “\+w A \+w certain \+w man \+w had \+w two \+w sons *

\+w The \+w younger \+w of \+w them \+w said \+w to \+w his \+w father ‘\+w Father \+w give \+w me \+w my \+w share \+w of \+w your property.’ \+w So \+w he \+w divided \+w his livelihood \+w between \+w them *

\+w Not \+w many \+w days \+w after \+w the \+w younger \+w son \+w gathered \+w all \+w of \+w this \+w together \+w and traveled \+w into \+w a \+w far \+w country \+w There \+w he \+w wasted \+w his property \+w with riotous \+w living *
\+w When \+w he \+w had \+w spent \+w all \+w of \+w it \+w there \+w arose \+w a \+w severe \+w famine \+w in \+w that \+w country \+w and \+w he \+w began \+w to \+w be \+w in \+w need *

\+w He \+w went \+w and \+w joined \+w himself \+w to \+w one \+w of \+w the \+w citizens \+w of \+w that \+w country \+w and \+w he \+w sent \+w him \+w into \+w his \+w fields \+w to \+w feed \+w pigs *
\+w He wanted \+w to \+w fill \+w his \+w belly \+w with \+w the \+w pods \+w that \+w the \+w pigs \+w ate \+w but \+w no \+w one \+w gave \+w him \+w any *

\+w But \+w when \+w he \+w came \+w to \+w himself \+w he \+w said ‘\+w How \+w many \+w hired servants \+w of \+w my \+w father \+w have bread \+w enough \+w to spare, \+w and \+w I dying \+w with \+w hunger *
\+w I \+w will \+w get \+w up \+w and \+w go \+w to \+w my \+w father \+w and \+w will \+w tell \+w him “\+w Father \+w I \+w have sinned \+w against \+w heaven \+w and \+w in \+w your \+w sight *
\+w I \+w am \+w no \+w more worthy \+w to \+w be \+w called \+w your \+w son \+w Make \+w me \+w as \+w one \+w of \+w your \+w hired servants.”’*

“\+w He arose \+w and \+w came \+w to \+w his \+w father \+w But \+w while \+w he \+w was \+w still \+w far \+w off \+w his \+w father \+w saw \+w him \+w and \+w was \+w moved \+w with \+w compassion \+w and \+w ran \+w fell \+w on \+w his \+w neck \+w and \+w kissed \+w him *

\+w The \+w son \+w said \+w to \+w him ‘\+w Father \+w I \+w have sinned \+w against \+w heaven \+w and \+w in \+w your \+w sight \+w I \+w am \+w no \+w longer worthy \+w to \+w be \+w called \+w your \+w son

“\+w But \+w the \+w father \+w said \+w to \+w his \+w servants ‘\+w Bring \+w out \+w the \+w best \+w robe \+w and \+w put \+w it \+w on \+w him \+w Put \+w a \+w ring \+w on \+w his \+w hand \+w and \+w sandals \+w on \+w his \+w feet *
\+w Bring \+w the \+w fattened \+w calf \+w kill \+w it \+w and \+w let \+w eat \+w and \+w celebrate *
\+w for \+w this \+w my \+w son \+w was \+w dead \+w and \+w is alive \+w again \+w He \+w was lost \+w and \+w is \+w found \+w Then \+w they began \+w to \+w celebrate
“\+w Now \+w his \+w elder \+w son \+w was \+w in \+w the field. \+w As \+w he \+w came \+w near \+w to \+w the \+w house \+w he heard \+w music \+w and \+w dancing *
\+w He \+w called \+w one \+w of \+w the \+w servants \+w to \+w him \+w and \+w asked \+w what \+w was \+w going \+w on *

\+w He \+w said \+w to \+w him ‘\+w Your brother \+w has \+w come \+w and \+w your \+w father \+w has \+w killed \+w the \+w fattened \+w calf \+w because \+w he \+w has received \+w him back \+w safe \+w and healthy.’ *
\+w But \+w he \+w was \+w angry \+w and \+w would \+w not \+w go \+w in \+w Therefore \+w his \+w father \+w came \+w out \+w and \+w begged \+w him *

\+w But \+w he \+w answered \+w his \+w father ‘\+w Behold \+w these \+w many \+w years \+w I \+w have \+w served \+w you \+w and \+w I \+w never \+w disobeyed \+w a \+w commandment \+w of \+w yours \+w but \+w you \+w never \+w gave \+w me \+w a \+w goat \+w that \+w I \+w might \+w celebrate \+w with \+w my \+w friends *
\+w But \+w when \+w this \+w your \+w son \+w came \+w who \+w has \+w devoured \+w your living \+w with \+w prostitutes \+w you \+w killed \+w the \+w fattened \+w calf \+w for \+w him
“\+w He \+w said \+w to \+w him ‘\+w Son \+w you \+w are \+w always \+w with \+w me \+w and \+w all \+w that \+w is \+w mine \+w is \+w yours *

\+w But \+w it \+w was appropriate \+w to \+w celebrate \+w and \+w be \+w glad \+w for \+w this \+w your brother, \+w was \+w dead \+w and \+w is \+w alive \+w again \+w He \+w was lost, \+w and \+w is \+w found
